facts.text: Kent, Lane, eat at your desks. The presses roll in twenty minutes.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Perry's real lines in the Wikiquote page are about Superman and Lois 'hooking up'. Nothing about desks or the presses.
facts.fix: Kent, Lane, eat at your desks. I want the Boravia story before the presses roll.

fix_note.text: Kent, Lane, eat at your desks. I want the Boravia story before the presses roll.

facts.text: Krypto ate the last batch. Not even Clark's dog.
facts.why: Krypto is Superman's own dog, so 'not even Clark's dog' reads backwards and the claim that he ate a batch is not in the film. Replaced with a plain menu joke.
facts.fix: Krypto ate the last batch. Good boy, bad manners.

vibe.verdict: A Daily Planet break room paper with Krypto, Lois's interview, the pocket universe and Guy Gardner's line all printing, though the dish writing is mild.
